title: Add Core2 stateful SSI batching and reconcile the legacy runtime boundary

execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13, Node 22, QEMU 9.2.2 virtual Core2

checks.name: ssi_batch_fallback_equivalence
checks.detail: Devices without transfer_buf keep the original per-byte behavior.

checks.name: m25p80_stateful_read_equivalence
checks.detail: 512 sampled 64-byte batches matched the original per-byte path with zero mismatches.

checks.name: command_address_dummy_cs_state
checks.detail: The fast path is limited to STATE_READ; existing phase handling remains authoritative.

checks.name: receive_only_spi_data_phase
checks.detail: ESP32 SPI uses transfer_buf only when the data phase has no transmitted bytes.

checks.name: core2_uiflow2_device_group
checks.detail: 6/6 cases and 24/24 checks passed without retry.

checks.name: shared_controller_full_uiflow2_matrix
checks.detail: 67/67 cases and 274/274 checks passed without retry.

checks.name: legacy_normal_watchdog_boot
checks.detail: The same legacy UIFlow image still reset without a non-empty application frame.

checks.name: legacy_watchdog_disabled_progress
checks.detail: The bounded WDT-disabled run did not reach setup text or REPL.

checks.name: crosscore_handshake
checks.detail: Flash-operation can-start/complete and cross-core reason flags completed repeatedly; a permanent deadlock is not supported.

checks.name: direct_read_repl_reproduction
checks.detail: The earlier temporary BlockBackend REPL result did not reproduce in the current rebuild.

notes: The stateful batch API is a controller-semantic optimization, not closure of RUNTIME-03.
A permanent cross-core deadlock hypothesis is retired; aggregate synchronous handoff throughput remains the leading hypothesis.
The direct BlockBackend path, WDT disable and accelerator overrides are diagnostics, not product behavior.
All results are virtual-device validation, not physical hardware validation.
The retained dirty QEMU worktree must not be reset or cleaned.
